recommendation.implementation_shape: Three bounded replacements only. Keep old released source files untouched; create a new guarded release.

resolution_contract: Validate input and preserve existing unique active identity slug resolution before checking availability; a duplicate slug must not fall back to a remaining available identity.
Resolve owner from the single chosen identity: private -> identities.user_id; business -> business_accounts.owner_user_id; unknown type or missing owner/state denies availability.

Use one indexed identity/business owner lookup and one account helper check per uniquely resolved profile request, before the content/category CTEs; measure the actual implementation to confirm this bound.

Unavailable account clears identity_value and uses the existing unavailable empty envelope, including profile_available false; categories identity_id null. Do not return raw null or a new error envelope.
No active-viewer identity authority, author/member fallback, owner bypass, account-state repair or row locking.

Do not silently import canonical profile header alias/fallback, business-status or owner-block semantics into these feeds; the bounded change is account availability, preserving each reader existing visibility rules.
actual_paths: PublicProfilePage -> get_store_by_slug through usePublicProfile/getPublicProfileBySlug; section rendering waits for profile.
usePublicProfileServiceView -> usePublicProfileStoreCategories(services) -> same category RPC; this RPC scope is in the profile gate, not a claim that standalone service content readers are finished.
PublicProfileListingCard routes typed ordinary IDs to /v2/listing/[id], horse IDs to /v2/horse-offer/[id].
Legacy marketplace_v1 remains directly granted to anon/authenticated and must be fenced despite no current app caller.
PublicProfileHorsesSection has no current app/src/components importing caller; it is not the current profile feed.

retained_semantics.temporary_hide: These direct profile readers have no temporary hidden-provider filter. Preserve deliberate visit behavior; do not import discovery hiding.
retained_semantics.v1_category: Horses only when category is null; category-selected v1 remains ordinary only.
retained_semantics.v2_category: Ordinary and horse membership comes from their separate canonical same-seller category links and same-identity descendants.
retained_semantics.contextual_category: Whole visible marketplace/services section before result filter/page; visible linked categories plus same-identity ancestors, recursive UNION; no unrelated seller branches.
retained_semantics.service_category_gate: Same profile/account gate applies to both marketplace/services because both return public profile metadata; service is_public and visible_to_viewer bodies remain byte exact.
retained_semantics.pagination: Market pages1..60, category pages1..100; offset0..100000; exact string total_count, items length, has_more, next_offset/window flag and original sort preserved.
retained_semantics.strict_clients: V1/V2 parsers reject unknown keys/version/seller and malformed pagination; category parser binds returned identity. Preserve exact empty envelope; RPC error remains error; no owner fallback.
retained_semantics.client_state: Existing audience/profile/filter/page request keys and AbortController hide prior scope; category API detects duplicate IDs/count changes/incomplete trees.
